prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Wide contemporary event invitation website hero backdrop, landscape approximately 1536x1024.
Primary request: A bold yet refined sculptural set with physically plausible fabrics and dimensional soft studio light. Create an elegant architectural photographic 3D scene in cool powder blue #dce8f1, with translucent blue organza suspended in one broad sweeping curve along the right and lower third, a rich oxblood satin ribbon passing behind the right focal area, and a small brushed-silver reflecting material detail integrated into the set.
Composition/framing: Landscape. Keep the left 45 percent clean cool powder blue negative space for dark wine typography. Keep the central/right middle largely open for a separate physical invitation ticket that will be overlaid by HTML. Fabric curves frame that open space rather than filling it. A layered swoop of translucent fabric runs along the lower edge as a strong foreground. Organza and ribbon must have pronounced substantial folds and discernible shadows at a website hero scale, not faint decoration.
Lighting/mood: Large soft directional photographic studio light, realistic fabric translucency, believable reflected highlights, rich dimensional occlusion at folds, high-end editorial event art direction.
Color palette: Cool powder blue #dce8f1 dominant, oxblood dark wine satin, restrained brushed silver reflections.
Materials/textures: Airy translucent blue organza with readable folds; soft glossy oxblood satin. Not plastic.
Constraints: Opaque complete backdrop. Only environment and materials. No ticket, rings or people. No text, letters, typography, logos, watermark, border or interface.
Avoid: neon, generic gradient blobs, weak imperceptible fabric, busy left half, confetti, particles, multiple unrelated objects, rainbow, excessive abstraction.
